meta.description: Open-source bookkeeping and accounting for UK and Estonian businesses.

footer.tagline: Open-source bookkeeping for the UK and Estonia.

landing.title: Open bookkeeping
landing.headline: Bookkeeping that stays clear, portable, and accountant-ready.
landing.lede: Create invoices, capture bills, reconcile cash, keep an immutable double-entry ledger, and prepare reviewed UK and Estonian VAT workpapers—without adopting a full ERP.
landing.invoice_body: Country-aware invoices, credit notes, payments, reminders, and a complete receivables trail.
landing.reconcile_body: Import statements, match with evidence and documents, and review ambiguity before anything posts.
landing.review_body: VAT workpapers, ledgers, reports, evidence, audit history, and explicit filing-agent plans.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.headline: Connect the tools your accountant already uses.
integrations.lede: FastAccounts can exchange data through tested provider adapters while making direction, ownership, review, and conflicts visible. No provider below is connected by default, and tax submission remains gated.
integrations.review_notice: Imports and exports produce reconciliation records. Direct tax submission stays disabled until provider approval, accountant UAT, and explicit finalisation controls are complete.

quickbooks.name: QuickBooks Online
quickbooks.description: Coexist with an existing QuickBooks company through reviewed imports and controlled exports.

xero.name: Xero
xero.description: Exchange accounting data with a Xero organisation using tenant-scoped OAuth and explicit conflict review.

merit.name: Merit Aktiva
merit.description: Support Estonian accountant workflows with HMAC-signed V2 invoice, payment, tax, GL and report exchange.

hmrc.name: HMRC Making Tax Digital
hmrc.description: Prepare accountant-reviewed VAT workpapers now; add sandbox obligations and submission flows before production approval.

emta.name: Estonian Tax and Customs Board
emta.logo_alt: Estonian Tax and Customs Board service mark
emta.description: Generate accountant-reviewed KMD and VD workpapers and retain a stub for a future supported filing channel.

open_banking.name: Open banking
open_banking.description: Read booked transactions through a selected AISP after GB/EE business-bank coverage and legal review.

login.title: Sign in
login.headline: Sign in to FastAccounts
login.body: Use an approved Google account. Local credentials and open registration are intentionally not enabled in this pilot.
login.configuration_hint: Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and the exact callback URI in your ignored .env.
